His aura is the electric tension before the storm, bringing both destructive power and life-giving rain, embodying the righteous fury of justice.
high_gods.lore: Shango-No-Inazuma began as a mortal king of legendary prowess who mastered the secret of calling lightning. His reign was one of dramatic justice—swift, fierce, and unforgettable. When jealous rivals poisoned him, he didn't die but ascended to the heavens, transforming into the embodiment of thunder itself. He took his double-headed axe with him, and now wields it to strike down the corrupt and protect the righteous. He is a god of passion and extremes: his love is as intense as his wrath, his celebrations as energetic as his battles. He taught humans the Bata drum rhythms that call his power, and his dance steps are said to be the origin of lightning patterns across the sky.
high_gods.appearance: A powerfully built man with skin like storm clouds, eyes that flash with lightning, wearing red and white royal garments. Carries the double-headed Oshe axe and is often surrounded by thunderclouds.
high_gods.ascension_story: Mortal king who ascended through self-will and mastery of lightning magic. Rather than accepting death by poison, he transformed himself into pure electrical energy and demanded a place among the Orishas.

unique_abilities.name: Ojo (Rainstorm)
unique_abilities.effect: Can summon devastating storms that purify through destruction
unique_abilities.cooldown: Storm required, can't create from nothing

unique_abilities.name: Thunder Judgment
unique_abilities.effect: His lightning strikes only the guilty, revealing hidden crimes
unique_abilities.cooldown: Requires clear evidence of wrongdoing

unique_abilities.name: Dance of Power
unique_abilities.effect: His ritual dances can charge objects or people with divine energy
unique_abilities.cooldown: Dance must be performed perfectly

high_gods.current_role: Enforcer of divine justice, patron of warriors and dancers, master of storms.
duties: Striking down corrupt leaders and oath-breakers
Bringing life-giving rain after droughts
Teaching warrior dances and combat rhythms
Protecting cities from supernatural threats
sacred_items: The Oshe Axe (channels lightning)
Thunder Stones (store storm energy)
Bata Drums (call his presence)
weaknesses: Cannot strike the truly innocent
Vulnerable to being trapped in absolute silence (no thunder)
Bound to answer any call for justice from a pure heart
Powerless against those with no fear of death

high_gods.name: Ogun-No-Tetsu, Lord of Iron
high_gods.title: Patron of All Who Use Metal
high_gods.god_of: Orisha who clears paths with his machete. Patron of blacksmiths, warriors, surgeons, and all who work with metal.
high_gods.description: Ogun-No-Tetsu manifests as the living essence of forged metal and relentless labor, a god of iron flesh and furnace heart, skin the color of polished steel and molten bronze, muscles like cable and piston, eyes glowing with forge-fire. He wears armor of living metal that grows with his movements, wields a machete that cuts through deception as easily as jungle, and stands amid floating anvils and gears. His body bears the scars of a thousand creations and destructions, each marking a lesson learned in the crucible of work. His aura smells of ozone, hot metal, and honest sweat, inspiring both the discipline to create and the courage to destroy when necessary.
high_gods.lore: Ogun-No-Tetsu was the first being to discover iron in the earth and learn its secrets. He forged the first tools, weapons, and machines, teaching humans how to transform raw materials into civilization. He cleared the first paths through primordial jungles with his machete, making way for villages, roads, and progress. Though a fierce warrior, he believes in the sanctity of honest labor—the sweat of the brow is prayer to him. He understands that every tool can be a weapon and every weapon a tool, and judges beings by how they use what he has given them. His forges burn eternally in hidden mountain hearts, where he repairs broken destinies and reforges flawed souls.
high_gods.appearance: A muscular, formidable figure with skin like polished iron, glowing forge-fire eyes, wearing minimal armor that seems grown from his body. Always carries his signature machete and is surrounded by tools and weapons.
high_gods.ascension_story: Emerged when the first intelligent being struck iron from stone and recognized its potential. Gained divinity through the collective worship of all who work with metal and tools.

unique_abilities.name: Ade (Crown of Mastery)
unique_abilities.effect: Grants mastery over any tool or weapon made of metal
unique_abilities.cooldown: Tool must be properly forged and cared for

unique_abilities.name: Path Clearing
unique_abilities.effect: His machete can cut through any obstacle, physical or magical
unique_abilities.cooldown: Path must lead to a worthy destination

unique_abilities.name: Forge of Souls
unique_abilities.effect: Can reforge damaged spirits and broken oaths in his divine furnace
unique_abilities.cooldown: Requires equivalent sacrifice of effort

high_gods.current_role: Master of all metalwork, opener of difficult paths, patron of warriors and workers.
duties: Teaching metalworking techniques to worthy mortals
Clearing paths for progress and civilization
Judging the worthiness of warriors and workers
Maintaining the balance between creation and destruction
sacred_items: The First Machete (cuts any material)
Eternal Anvil (can shape any metal)
Forge-Bellows (breathes life into creations)

rivals: Those who use tools for unnecessary destruction

weaknesses: Cannot refuse a request for help with honest labor
Powerless against beings or materials without metal
Bound to complete any task he begins
Vulnerable to rust and corrosion magic

high_gods.name: Eshu-No-Sakusen, The Trickster Messenger
high_gods.title: Keeper of the Crossroads
high_gods.god_of: Orisha who delivers sacrifices to gods and carries messages between realms. Opener of ways and bringer of fortune/misfortune.
high_gods.description: Eshu-No-Sakusen manifests as the living crossroads of possibility, a god of infinite faces and shifting intentions, skin that changes color like mood, eyes that show different truths to each beholder, form that is simultaneously young and ancient, male and female. He wears a hat that points in all directions at once, carries a staff carved with every language ever spoken and some not yet invented, and stands where all paths converge and diverge. His smile promises fortune or ruin with equal sincerity, and his laughter echoes with the sound of doors opening and closing. His aura is the disorienting thrill of unexpected opportunity, the dangerous excitement of the unknown path, reminding all that every beginning requires an ending elsewhere.
high_gods.lore: Eshu-No-Sakusen was created by Olodumare-No-Hasshin as the divine messenger and keeper of balance. He exists at every crossroads, both literal and metaphorical, ensuring that choices have consequences and messages are delivered—though not always as intended. He is neither good nor evil but necessary chaos, testing assumptions and breaking routines. Without Eshu, the universe would stagnate; with him, it remains dynamic and unpredictable. He delivered the first sacrifice from humans to gods, establishing the connection between realms. His tricks are lessons in disguise, and his mischief often prevents greater disasters by forcing beings to pay attention.
high_gods.appearance: A being of shifting appearance, sometimes young, sometimes old, male or female, always dressed in colorful, mismatched clothes. Wears a distinctive hat with multiple brims and carries a carved staff.
high_gods.ascension_story: Created specifically by Olodumare-No-Hasshin to be the divine messenger and agent of change. Emerged fully formed from the first choice ever made in the universe.

unique_abilities.name: Ona (The Path)
unique_abilities.effect: Can open or close any path, opportunity, or communication channel
unique_abilities.cooldown: Must maintain cosmic balance (for every opened path, one must close)

unique_abilities.name: Message Multiplicity
unique_abilities.effect: Can deliver the same message differently to each recipient based on what they need to hear
unique_abilities.cooldown: Message must be true at its core

unique_abilities.name: Choice Amplification
unique_abilities.effect: Can make the consequences of any choice more dramatic and immediate
unique_abilities.cooldown: Cannot create choices, only enhance existing ones

high_gods.current_role: Divine messenger between realms, keeper of crossroads, agent of necessary chaos.
duties: Carrying messages and sacrifices between humans and Orishas
Testing the wisdom of those at crossroads
Preventing stagnation through controlled chaos
Maintaining the balance of fortune and misfortune
sacred_items: The Crossroads Staff (points to all possibilities)
Message Bag (holds infinite communications without mixing)
Trickster's Dice (always land on interesting outcomes)
weaknesses: Cannot interfere with free will directly
Must deliver any message given to him, no matter the consequences
Powerless at dead ends with no choices
Bound by the rules of the game even when he creates it

low_gods.name: Oshun-No-Kawa, River of Honey
low_gods.title: Goddess of Sweet Waters
low_gods.god_of: Orisha of sweet waters, love, and diplomacy. Most beautiful Orisha who heals with honey.
low_gods.description: Oshun-No-Kawa flows into being as a goddess of liquid gold and sweet seduction, her form the perfect curves of riverbeds and waterfalls, skin the color of sunlit honey, hair that flows like amber currents, eyes holding the sparkling dance of light on fresh water. She wears five brass bracelets that chime with the music of prosperity, and her laughter makes flowers bloom and hearts open. Her aura carries the scent of orange blossoms and river mist, promising wealth, love, and healing to those who approach with respect, but dangerous currents to the arrogant.
low_gods.lore: Oshun-No-Kawa was born when Yemoja-No-Umi's tears of joy fell into a sunbeam and transformed into a golden river. She is the youngest of the major river Orishas but the most beloved for her sweet nature and healing touch. When the other Orishas refused to help humans during a drought, Oshun alone took pity and taught them how to find underground springs and collect morning dew. She is the patron of diplomacy, teaching that sweetness opens more doors than force. Her honey heals both physical wounds and broken hearts, and her waters are said to restore fertility to both land and people. She once saved the world by using her beauty and wit to trick a destructive spirit into revealing its weakness.
low_gods.appearance: A stunningly beautiful woman with golden-brown skin that shimmers like honey in sunlight, wearing flowing yellow and gold garments adorned with brass jewelry. Always surrounded by butterflies and sweet scents.
low_gods.ascension_story: Born as a river spirit from Yemoja's tears, she gained full Orisha status when she single-handedly ended the Great Drought by negotiating with the rain spirits and showing humans hidden water sources.

unique_abilities.name: Honey Healing
unique_abilities.effect: Her honey can heal any wound or illness, and her waters can restore fertility to barren beings or lands
unique_abilities.cooldown: Seasonal, aligned with river cycles

unique_abilities.name: Golden Persuasion
unique_abilities.effect: Can charm and persuade any being through beauty, wit, or sweet words
unique_abilities.cooldown: Cannot affect those completely immune to emotion

unique_abilities.name: Wealth Attraction
unique_abilities.effect: Can attract prosperity and good fortune to those who honor her properly
unique_abilities.cooldown: Requires sincere devotion and clean intentions

low_gods.current_role: Goddess of rivers, love, beauty, and prosperity; chief diplomat among Orishas.
duties: Maintaining the flow and purity of fresh waters
Healing emotional and physical wounds
Teaching diplomacy and peaceful conflict resolution
Blessing marriages and love relationships
sacred_items: The Five Brass Bracelets (control river currents)
Golden Mirror (shows true inner beauty)
Honey Jar (never empties of healing honey)
weaknesses: Cannot tolerate ugliness, cruelty, or pollution
Weakened by salt water (her domain is fresh water only)
Bound to help anyone who approaches her rivers with pure heart
Vulnerable to flattery and beautiful things (can be distracted)

low_gods.name: Oya-No-Arashi, Storm of Change
low_gods.title: Goddess of Winds and Transformation
low_gods.god_of: Orisha of violent winds, lightning, and radical change. Guardian of cemetery gates. Shango's favorite wife.
low_gods.description: Oya-No-Arashi manifests as the tornado given goddess form, a being of whirling skirts made of rainbow and lightning, skin the color of storm-tossed skies, hair that crackles with static and whips like hurricane winds. She wields a sword of wind that can cut spirit from body, and stands guard at the gate between life and death, her nine skirts representing the nine winds of change. Her eyes show the calm at the storm's center and the destruction at its edges, and her voice is the howl of necessary transformation. Her aura is the electric charge of impending revolution, sweeping away the old to make room for new growth.
low_gods.lore: Oya-No-Arashi began as a gentle breeze spirit until she witnessed the injustice of unchanging systems. She sought power to create change and found it in the heart of the greatest storm. She married Shango-No-Inazuma, becoming his equal in passion and power. Together they create the most dramatic thunderstorms. Oya guards the cemetery gates because she understands that death is the ultimate change, and she ensures souls pass through properly. She is the patron of revolutionaries, those who must destroy to rebuild, and women who defy tradition. Her nine winds each carry different aspects of change: one for new beginnings, one for necessary endings, one for sudden insights, etc.
low_gods.appearance: A fierce, beautiful woman with skin like storm clouds, wearing nine colorful skirts that swirl around her, hair dancing with lightning. Carries a sword made of wind and stands at cemetery gates.
low_gods.ascension_story: Began as a minor wind spirit who gained power by merging with a sentient tornado. Achieved full Orisha status when she helped Shango ascend and proved herself as guardian of the afterlife gates.

unique_abilities.name: Nine Winds
unique_abilities.effect: Can summon nine different winds, each with specific transformative properties (from gentle breeze of change to hurricane of revolution)
unique_abilities.cooldown: One wind at a time, changing requires concentration

unique_abilities.name: Gatekeeping
unique_abilities.effect: Can open or close the gates between life and death, preventing unnatural resurrection or untimely death
unique_abilities.cooldown: Only at cemetery gates or places of recent death

unique_abilities.name: Change Catalyst
unique_abilities.effect: Can accelerate necessary changes in societies, individuals, or environments
unique_abilities.cooldown: Cannot force change where none is needed

low_gods.current_role: Guardian of cemetery gates, agent of radical change, storm-bringer alongside Shango.
duties: Guarding the passage between life and death
Bringing necessary storms to clear stagnation
Protecting women who defy unjust traditions
Teaching the wisdom of embracing change
sacred_items: The Wind Sword (cuts through resistance to change)
Nine-Skirt Garment (each skirt controls a different wind)
Cemetery Key (opens any gate between realms)
weaknesses: Cannot act against the natural cycle of life and death
Weakened in completely still, stagnant air
Bound to guard any cemetery gate she encounters
Vulnerable to being trapped by rituals that freeze time

low_gods.name: Orunmila-No-Yogen, Witness to Destiny
low_gods.title: Orisha of Wisdom and Divination
low_gods.god_of: Orisha of wisdom who knows all destinies. Only Orisha present with Olodumare at creation.
low_gods.description: Orunmila-No-Yogen sits in eternal contemplation of the 256 Odus of destiny, a god of infinite patience and foresight, skin like ancient ivory carved with sacred patterns, eyes that see all possible futures like branching rivers, hands that hold the divination chain that measures cosmic balance. He wears the robes of a sage woven from answered questions and unasked ones, and around him float the sixteen sacred palm nuts that contain all knowledge. His aura is the profound silence of absolute understanding, the weight of knowing what must be without the power to change it, only to guide.
low_gods.lore: Orunmila-No-Yogen was present when Olodumare-No-Hasshin first spoke the universe into being. He witnessed every destiny being woven into the cosmic fabric. He knows the 256 Odus (destiny patterns) that govern all existence. Though he cannot change what is destined, he can show the various paths within a destiny and advise on the wisest choices. He taught humans the art of Ifá divination so they could understand their paths. He is the patron of all diviners, scholars, and truth-seekers. His wisdom comes with a heavy burden: knowing what must happen but being unable to intervene directly, only to guide others to their proper paths.
low_gods.appearance: An ancient, wise figure with skin like aged ivory, deep knowing eyes, wearing simple sage robes. Always surrounded by floating palm nuts, divination chains, and sacred texts.
low_gods.ascension_story: Created by Olodumare-No-Hasshin as the witness and recorder of creation. Gained his status by memorizing all 256 Odus of destiny and developing the Ifá divination system to share this knowledge.

unique_abilities.name: Odu Sight
unique_abilities.effect: Can see the complete destiny pattern (Odu) of any being or situation
unique_abilities.cooldown: Revealing full patterns is mentally exhausting

unique_abilities.name: Ifá Consultation
unique_abilities.effect: Can provide perfectly accurate divination and advice through any divination system
unique_abilities.cooldown: Seeker must ask sincere questions and accept answers

unique_abilities.name: Wisdom Echo
unique_abilities.effect: Can temporarily grant others the accumulated wisdom of ages on a specific topic
unique_abilities.cooldown: Recipient must be truly seeking understanding

low_gods.current_role: Supreme diviner and wisdom-keeper, advisor to gods and mortals, teacher of destiny.
duties: Maintaining the records of all destinies
Teaching the Ifá divination system to worthy priests
Advising other Orishas on cosmic matters
Helping mortals understand their life paths
sacred_items: The Sixteen Palm Nuts (contain all knowledge)
Opele Divination Chain (reveals destiny patterns)
Iroke Ifá Staff (points to truth)
weaknesses: Cannot act against destined outcomes
Bound to answer any sincere question of importance
Powerless against absolute randomness (which has no pattern)
Vulnerable to being asked questions he cannot answer (rare)

low_gods.name: Osanyin-No-Yakuso, Lord of Herbs
low_gods.title: Master of Medicinal Plants
low_gods.god_of: Orisha of herbal medicine and forest. Crippled but most knowledgeable healer.
low_gods.description: Osanyin-No-Yakuso manifests as the forest given consciousness, a god whose body is woven from vines, leaves, and healing roots, skin textured like bark with glowing sap-veins, one leg strong as an ironwood tree, the other withered but pulsing with potent medicine. He wears a crown of medicinal plants that shift with needed cures, and his single eye sees both the disease and its remedy in all things. His aura carries the scent of a thousand healing herbs, the damp richness of fertile soil, and the quiet power of nature's pharmacy.
low_gods.lore: Osanyin-No-Yakuso was once a handsome, fully-abled forest spirit who knew every plant's secret. When a great plague threatened all life, he sacrificed his beauty and mobility to discover the ultimate cure. He traveled through the most dangerous parts of the forest, losing an eye to poisonous thorns and crippling one leg in a magical swamp, but emerged with knowledge that saved countless lives. Now he appears as a crippled, one-eyed being, but his knowledge is unparalleled. He teaches that true healing often requires sacrifice, and that the most potent medicines grow in the most difficult places. He is the patron of herbalists, doctors, and all who seek cures in nature.
low_gods.appearance: A being with one strong leg and one withered leg, one eye missing, skin like bark with glowing green veins. Wears living plant garments and a crown of medicinal herbs.
low_gods.ascension_story: Began as a forest spirit who gained Orisha status through self-sacrifice and unparalleled healing knowledge. Achieved divinity when he cured a plague that even other Orishas couldn't heal.

unique_abilities.name: Plant Communion
unique_abilities.effect: Can communicate with and understand all plants, learning their medicinal properties instantly
unique_abilities.cooldown: Continuous, but exhausting with many plants

unique_abilities.name: Sacrificial Healing
unique_abilities.effect: Can cure any ailment by transferring it to a plant or taking on some symptoms himself
unique_abilities.cooldown: Requires appropriate sacrificial plant or personal sacrifice

unique_abilities.name: Forest Sight
unique_abilities.effect: His single eye can see illness in any being and identify the exact plant needed for cure
unique_abilities.cooldown: Continuous, but causes headaches with overuse

low_gods.current_role: Master herbalist and healer, protector of medicinal forests, teacher of plant magic.
duties: Maintaining the world's medicinal plant knowledge
Teaching herbalists proper harvesting techniques
Protecting rare healing plants from overharvesting
Healing illnesses that resist conventional treatment
sacred_items: The Living Crown (grows whatever medicinal plant is needed)
Herbalist's Bag (holds infinite plant materials)
Healing Staff (can detect illness with a touch)

allies: Vanadevi (forest companion from Eldoria when pantheons interact)
rivals: Those who destroy forests for profit

weaknesses: Cannot heal in completely artificial environments
Weakened by synthetic chemicals and pollution
Bound to help anyone suffering from curable illness
Vulnerable to fire (as forests are)

low_gods.name: Aje-Shaluga-No-Zai, Wealth from Sea
low_gods.title: Goddess of Oceanic Prosperity
low_gods.god_of: Orisha of wealth and economic prosperity. Brings abundance from sea and trade.
low_gods.description: Aje-Shaluga-No-Zai rises from ocean depths bearing treasures, a goddess whose skin shimmers with mother-of-pearl and gold dust, hair woven with coral and pearls, eyes that reflect the glitter of sunken treasure. She wears necklaces of cowrie shells that multiply in her presence, and her hands pour forth abundance from an endless basket. Her aura is the prosperous feeling of a full net and a safe harbor, the excitement of fair trade and just profit, the security that comes from wisely managed abundance.
low_gods.lore: Aje-Shaluga-No-Zai was born when the first merchant successfully traded across the sea. She represents not just wealth, but wealth earned through honest exchange and maritime enterprise. She blesses fishermen with full nets, traders with profitable journeys, and communities with economic stability. Unlike greedy wealth spirits, she teaches that true prosperity comes from circulation, not hoarding. She once caused a miser's gold to transform into seashells to teach him about the natural flow of abundance. She is particularly fond of cowrie shells, which were once used as currency, and blesses those who use wealth to help their communities.
low_gods.appearance: A regal woman with skin that shimmers like pearls, wearing elaborate jewelry made of sea treasures. Always carries a basket that overflows with wealth and is surrounded by schools of valuable fish.
low_gods.ascension_story: Emerged as a spirit of successful maritime trade. Gained Orisha status when she helped establish the first intercontinental trade routes and taught humans about fair commerce.

unique_abilities.name: Abundance Flow
unique_abilities.effect: Can cause wealth and resources to flow to those who use them wisely and generously
unique_abilities.cooldown: Cannot create wealth from nothing, only redirect existing flows

unique_abilities.name: Sea Bounty
unique_abilities.effect: Can fill fishing nets, attract pearl oysters, or guide ships to profitable trade
unique_abilities.cooldown: Tidal cycle based

unique_abilities.name: Wealth Sight
unique_abilities.effect: Can see the true value of things (not just monetary) and how wealth flows through communities
unique_abilities.cooldown: Continuous

low_gods.current_role: Patron of maritime trade, fishing, and fair commerce; goddess of circulating wealth.
duties: Blessing honest merchants and fair trades
Ensuring fishing communities have abundant catches
Teaching wise wealth management and generosity
Preventing economic stagnation and hoarding
sacred_items: The Endless Basket (produces appropriate wealth for needs)
Cowrie Necklace (attracts fair trade opportunities)
Merchant's Scale (always balances fairly)
weaknesses: Cannot bless dishonest or exploitative commerce
Weakened in landlocked areas far from trade routes
Bound to help communities facing economic collapse
Vulnerable to curses of poverty that attack community spirit

low_gods.name: Oko-No-Kome, Lord of Harvest
low_gods.title: God of Agriculture
low_gods.god_of: Orisha of farming and harvest. Ensures bounty from earth.
low_gods.description: Oko-No-Kome stands with feet rooted in fertile soil, a god of bountiful harvests and patient growth, skin the rich brown of well-tilled earth, hair like ripe grain flowing in wind, hands that can make seeds sprout in moments. He wears simple farmer's garments that are always clean despite the soil, and carries a hoe that never breaks and a basket that never empties. His aura is the satisfying weight of a full harvest moon, the promise of rain after drought, the simple joy of food grown with one's own labor.
low_gods.lore: Oko-No-Kome taught humanity agriculture when they were still hunter-gatherers. He showed them how to domesticate plants, rotate crops, and store grains for winter. He is a practical, no-nonsense Orisha who believes in the dignity of labor and the sacredness of feeding others. He blesses those who work the land with care and punishes those who waste food or farm selfishly. He works closely with Yemoja-No-Umi for irrigation and with various weather Orishas for proper growing conditions. His festivals celebrate harvest and planting seasons, and he is particularly honored by farming communities.
low_gods.appearance: A sturdy, strong man with earth-toned skin, wearing simple farmer's clothes, carrying agricultural tools. Surrounded by growing plants and ripe produce.
low_gods.ascension_story: Emerged as the spirit of the first successful farm. Gained Orisha status when he taught agriculture to multiple civilizations, ensuring their survival and growth.

unique_abilities.name: Instant Growth
unique_abilities.effect: Can make plants grow from seed to harvest in moments, but only for true need
unique_abilities.cooldown: Drains fertility from surrounding land temporarily

unique_abilities.name: Soil Blessing
unique_abilities.effect: Can restore fertility to depleted soil or purify contaminated land
unique_abilities.cooldown: Seasonal, requires proper agricultural practices afterward

unique_abilities.name: Harvest Vision
unique_abilities.effect: Can see the future yield of any field and predict agricultural success or failure
unique_abilities.cooldown: Continuous during growing seasons

low_gods.current_role: Patron of farmers and agriculture, guardian of food security, teacher of sustainable farming.
duties: Ensuring bountiful harvests for hardworking farmers
Teaching sustainable agricultural techniques
Protecting farmland from corruption and blight
Blessing seeds and first fruits
sacred_items: The Unbreaking Hoe (tills any soil)
Seed Basket (provides perfect seeds for any climate)
Harvest Sickle (harvests only ripe crops)
weaknesses: Cannot help those who won't work the land themselves
Weakened in non-agricultural areas (cities, deserts)
Bound to prevent famine when possible
Vulnerable to artificial fertilizers and GMOs that bypass natural cycles

low_gods.name: Ibeji-No-Futago, Divine Twins
low_gods.title: Gods of Twinhood and Joy
low_gods.god_of: Twin Orishas representing childlike joy and the special power of twins.
low_gods.description: Ibeji-No-Futago appear as inseparable twins of perfect mirrored beauty, one male, one female, with skin like polished ebony and eyes that sparkle with eternal childhood mischief. They wear identical garments of bright colors that change to please the viewer, and play with toys that are also sacred objects—drums that beat with heart rhythms, dolls that offer protection, balls that contain miniature worlds. Their laughter heals sorrow, their play teaches balance, and their combined aura is the pure, uncomplicated joy of companionship and shared existence.
low_gods.lore: The Ibeji-No-Futago were born as the first twins in the world, and their unique bond caught the attention of the Orishas. They never aged, maintaining eternal childhood and becoming symbols of the special connection between twins. They protect all twins, ensuring they share a spiritual bond that transcends physical separation. They also represent the joy and innocence of childhood, and their play is said to maintain the balance between work and leisure in the world. When one twin dies young, the Ibeji care for the surviving twin's soul, and they are often invoked to protect children from harm.
low_gods.appearance: Perfectly identical boy and girl twins around 7 years old, wearing matching colorful clothes, always holding hands or playing together.
low_gods.ascension_story: Born as mortal twins with such a strong spiritual bond that they ascended together, becoming eternal children and protectors of all twins.

unique_abilities.name: Twin Bond
unique_abilities.effect: Can create or strengthen psychic/emotional bonds between twins or close siblings
unique_abilities.cooldown: Both parties must consent to the bond

unique_abilities.name: Joy Infusion
unique_abilities.effect: Their laughter and play can heal depression, lighten hearts, and restore childlike wonder
unique_abilities.cooldown: Cannot affect those completely immune to joy

unique_abilities.name: Mirrored Protection
unique_abilities.effect: What affects one twin affects the other, allowing them to share burdens or double blessings
unique_abilities.cooldown: Must be in physical contact or very close proximity

low_gods.current_role: Protectors of twins and children, bringers of joy, maintainers of sibling bonds.
duties: Protecting twins from harm and ensuring their special bond
Bringing joy and playfulness to overly serious situations
Comforting children who have lost siblings
Teaching the importance of balance between work and play
sacred_items: Twin Dolls (protect children and twins)
Joy Drums (beat with the rhythm of laughter)
Mirror Ball (shows what one twin sees to the other)
weaknesses: Cannot act separately (must always be together)
Powerless against those who have completely lost their inner child
Bound to protect any twin in danger
Vulnerable to forces that cause permanent separation

low_gods.name: Olosa-No-Umi, Lagoon Mother
low_gods.title: Goddess of Lagoons and Estuaries
low_gods.god_of: Orisha of lagoons and fish abundance. Wife of Olokun.
low_gods.description: Olosa-No-Umi dwells where saltwater meets fresh, a goddess of calm waters and hidden depths, skin the shifting green of lagoon waters, hair like floating seaweed adorned with shells and tiny crabs, eyes that watch both surface and depth simultaneously. She wears nets that catch only what is needed, and her presence makes fish gather and waters calm. Her aura is the peaceful abundance of a protected cove, the security of calm waters, the gentle nourishment of brackish ecosystems where life thrives in balance.
low_gods.lore: Olosa-No-Umi is the goddess of the liminal spaces where ocean meets land—lagoons, estuaries, mangroves, and tidal pools. These are some of the most fertile and protective ecosystems, and she ensures their balance. She taught humans how to fish sustainably in these rich waters and how to use mangrove forests for protection from storms. As wife of Olokun (god of the deep sea), she mediates between the terrifying depths and the safe shallows. She is particularly protective of coastal communities and the unique life forms that thrive in brackish waters. Her temper is usually calm, but when her lagoons are threatened, she can summon protective fogs and confusing currents.
low_gods.appearance: A serene woman with greenish skin that shifts like lagoon waters, wearing garments of seaweed and shells. Often shown in or near mangrove forests or calm lagoons.
low_gods.ascension_story: Emerged as the consciousness of the first lagoon ecosystem. Gained Orisha status when she protected coastal communities from a tsunami by raising mangrove barriers.

unique_abilities.name: Brackish Balance
unique_abilities.effect: Can maintain perfect balance between salt and fresh water in estuaries, creating ideal conditions for abundant life
unique_abilities.cooldown: Requires both salt and fresh water sources

unique_abilities.name: Lagoon Protection
unique_abilities.effect: Can summon protective fogs, confuse enemies with shifting currents, or hide communities in mangrove mazes
unique_abilities.cooldown: Only works in or near lagoon ecosystems

unique_abilities.name: Sustainable Abundance
unique_abilities.effect: Can ensure fishing communities catch exactly what they need without depleting stocks
unique_abilities.cooldown: Fishermen must follow sustainable practices

low_gods.current_role: Protector of lagoon ecosystems, patron of sustainable fishing, guardian of coastal communities.
duties: Maintaining the health of lagoon and estuary ecosystems
Teaching sustainable fishing and harvesting techniques
Protecting coastal communities from storms and invaders
Preserving mangrove forests and other coastal protections
sacred_items: The Mangrove Staff (controls tidal flows)
Lagoon Net (catches only what is needed)
Shell Crown (commands crustaceans and mollusks)
weaknesses: Powerless far from coastlines or brackish waters
Cannot tolerate complete stagnation or complete turbulence
Bound to protect any threatened lagoon ecosystem
Vulnerable to oil spills and chemical pollution

low_gods.name: Babalu-Aye-No-Iyashi, Healer of Plague
low_gods.title: God of Disease and Healing
low_gods.god_of: Orisha who heals infectious diseases. Walks with crutches covered in sores he heals in others.
low_gods.description: Babalu-Aye-No-Iyashi walks with a crutch made of sacred wood, a god covered in sores that glow with healing light rather than infection, skin showing both disease and its cure in equal measure, eyes that see suffering without flinching. He wears simple cloth that absorbs illness from others, and his presence makes mosquitoes avoid the worthy and pests leave the pure of heart. His aura carries the scent of medicinal herbs and clean bandages, the quiet dignity of suffering endured with grace, the profound relief of fever breaking.
low_gods.lore: Babalu-Aye-No-Iyashi began as a healer so skilled he could cure any disease. When a great plague struck that even he couldn't cure, he deliberately infected himself to study it from within. He suffered for years, covered in sores and walking with crutches, but eventually found the cure. Instead of healing himself completely, he kept some symptoms as a reminder and as a reservoir of healing power. Now he appears as a diseased being, but his sores contain cures for countless illnesses. He teaches that true healing requires understanding suffering from within, and that doctors must maintain compassion. He is invoked both to prevent disease and to heal it, and is particularly associated with smallpox, AIDS, and other epidemic diseases.
low_gods.appearance: An older man covered in glowing sores, walking with crutches, wearing simple cloth garments. Despite his diseased appearance, he radiates healing energy.
low_gods.ascension_story: Mortal healer who achieved Orisha status through self-sacrifice and ultimate medical knowledge. Ascended when he found cures for seven great plagues that threatened all life.

unique_abilities.name: Disease Absorption
unique_abilities.effect: Can take diseases from others into himself, where they transform into healing knowledge and power
unique_abilities.cooldown: Becomes temporarily weaker as he processes each new disease

unique_abilities.name: Epidemic Control
unique_abilities.effect: Can stop the spread of infectious diseases or contain outbreaks
unique_abilities.cooldown: Requires understanding of the disease's nature

unique_abilities.name: Healing Sores
unique_abilities.effect: The pus from his sores contains cures for the diseases they represent
unique_abilities.cooldown: Limited by how many diseases he currently carries

low_gods.current_role: God of healing infectious diseases, patron of doctors and nurses, teacher of medical compassion.
duties: Healing epidemic diseases
Teaching doctors and healers
Controlling disease outbreaks
Protecting communities from plagues
sacred_items: The Healing Crutch (can diagnose illness with a touch)
Bag of Medicinal Herbs (always contains needed remedies)
Sore Cloth (absorbs illness from others)
weaknesses: Cannot heal diseases he hasn't personally experienced
Weakened by perfect health and sterility (no diseases to work with)
Bound to help anyone suffering from infectious disease
Vulnerable to being overwhelmed by too many new diseases at once

low_gods.name: Nana-Buruku-No-Kigen, Primal Grandmother
low_gods.title: Ancient Mother of Beginnings
low_gods.god_of: Oldest Orisha, grandmother of all. Represents primordial swamp of creation.
low_gods.description: Nana-Buruku-No-Kigen sits in the primordial swamp of creation, a goddess so ancient she remembers when water first learned it was wet, skin like dark fertile mud studded with the first stars, hair like river deltas flowing in all directions, eyes that show the universe before light had a name. She wears only the respect due to the first mother, and her hands still drip with the clay from which Obatala learned to shape humans. Her aura is the profound mystery of beginnings, the terrifying fertility of chaos before order, the sacred darkness from which all light is born.
low_gods.lore: Nana-Buruku-No-Kigen is the oldest of the Orishas, present when existence was just a swamp of possibilities. She is the primordial womb from which all life eventually emerged. She remembers everything that has ever been forgotten, and knows secrets that even Olodumare-No-Hasshin has set aside. She taught Obatala-No-Jozu how to shape humans from clay, and gave Yemoja-No-Umi her first waters. She is both terrifying and comforting—the chaos before order, the mystery before understanding, the darkness before light. She is particularly honored by elders, midwives assisting with difficult births, and those working with deep mysteries. Her worship is simple but profound, involving mud, silence, and respect for ancient things.
low_gods.appearance: An extremely ancient woman with skin like dark mud containing stars, flowing hair like river deltas, sitting in a primordial swamp. Her form shifts between solid and liquid.
low_gods.ascension_story: The first consciousness to emerge from the primordial chaos. Not ascended but primordial—existed before the concept of divinity, and will exist after.

unique_abilities.name: Primordial Memory
unique_abilities.effect: Remembers everything that has ever been, including things forgotten by gods and erased from history
unique_abilities.cooldown: Recalling specific memories takes time proportional to their age

unique_abilities.name: Chaos Womb
unique_abilities.effect: Can return anything to its primordial state for re-creation, or bring forth entirely new things from chaos
unique_abilities.cooldown: Only during cosmic alignments or at places of power

unique_abilities.name: Ancient Protection
unique_abilities.effect: Can protect beings, places, or knowledge by making them part of primordial mystery
unique_abilities.cooldown: What she protects becomes mysterious even to itself

low_gods.current_role: Keeper of primordial mysteries, grandmother advisor to all Orishas, guardian of true beginnings.
duties: Remembering all that has been forgotten
Guarding the primordial swamp of creation
Advising other Orishas on ancient matters
Protecting the mystery at the heart of existence
sacred_items: The First Mud (can become anything)
Star-Sewn Net (catches forgotten knowledge)
Ancient Calabash (holds primordial waters)

rivals: Forces that want everything known and controlled
Those who disrespect elders and ancient things
advises: Beings at the beginning of great journeys

weaknesses: Cannot comprehend or affect things that are completely new (with no connection to the past)
Weakened by excessive order and predictability
Bound to remember everything, even what she wishes to forget
Vulnerable to being trapped in linear time

demi_gods.name: Tunde-Ala
demi_gods.title: The Clay-Born King
demi_gods.full_title: He Whose Body Was Reforged From Sacred Earth After Betrayal
demi_gods.mortal_origin: King of the Oyo Kingdom who was betrayed and buried alive by his brothers
demi_gods.ascension_story: When Tunde's brothers betrayed him and buried him in unconsecrated earth, the land itself recognized his just rule. For seven years he slowly transformed, the soil becoming flesh, roots becoming veins, stones becoming bones. When he emerged, he was no longer fully human but a being of living earth. Obatala-No-Jozu witnessed this self-creation and declared, 'This king has learned the patience of clay.' He infused Tunde with Ashe from the first human mold, making him demi-divine.
demi_gods.appearance: A man of living terra cotta, with skin that shows geographic features (rivers, mountains), hair like dry grass, eyes that glow like buried embers. His body occasionally sprouts flowers or small plants. Wears royal garments that grow from his body like bark.

unique_abilities.name: Earth Memory
unique_abilities.effect: Can read the history of any place by touching the ground, seeing all that has happened there
unique_abilities.limitations: Only works on natural earth; paved or purified areas give fragmented memories

unique_abilities.name: Royal Resonance
unique_abilities.effect: His voice compels truth from those who swore oaths to him, making betrayal physically painful for oath-breakers
unique_abilities.limitations: Only affects those who personally pledged loyalty; strangers are unaffected

demi_gods.current_role: Wandering judge of royal disputes and betrayed rulers
duties: Settles succession disputes in royal families
Teaches newly crowned rulers about the burdens of kingship
Maintains the Tomb of Betrayed Kings
Guards sacred burial grounds from desecration
sacred_items: The Scepter of Unbroken Oaths (glows when near oath-breakers)
Crown of Living Roots (connects to ancestral memories)
temples: Court of Earthly Justice (a mobile court that appears where needed)
Shrine at his original burial site

rivals: His still-mortal brothers (who fear his return)
Corrupt officials who thrive on betrayal

weaknesses: Weakened by salt (which purifies earth)
Cannot cross large bodies of water (earth dissolves)
Compelled to hear any case of royal betrayal brought before him

demi_gods.name: Amina-Mami
demi_gods.title: The River's Midwife
demi_gods.full_title: She Who Delivers Both Babies and River Spirits
demi_gods.mortal_origin: Midwife from a river village who delivered babies during the Great Flood
demi_gods.ascension_story: When the rivers overflowed and threatened to drown her village, Amina didn't flee. Instead, she waded into the rising waters and began delivering not just human babies, but also the newborn river spirits struggling to be born from the flood. For forty days she worked without rest, her hands becoming translucent like water. Yemoja-No-Umi, seeing this selfless service, pulled her into the river's heart and replaced her blood with living water, making her the eternal midwife of transitions.
demi_gods.appearance: A woman with skin like clear river water showing fish swimming beneath, hair that flows like currents, eyes that reflect whatever is being born nearby. Her hands are always slightly wet. Wears practical midwife's garments that never get soiled.

unique_abilities.name: Birth Waters
unique_abilities.effect: Can create a protective sphere of amniotic energy around any being in transition (birth, death, transformation)
unique_abilities.limitations: Sphere lasts only as long as the transition; cannot prevent inevitable outcomes

unique_abilities.name: Spirit Umbilicus
unique_abilities.effect: Can temporarily connect two beings (or a being and a place) like mother and child, allowing safe energy transfer
unique_abilities.limitations: Connection must be severed naturally or both suffer damage

demi_gods.current_role: Guardian of all births near water and spiritual transitions
duties: Attends births that occur during rains or near water
Helps newborn river spirits find their courses
Teaches water-safe midwifery techniques
Maintains the Pool of First Cries
sacred_items: The Umbilical Cord (never cuts living connections, only severs dead ones)
Waters of Transition (helps any change proceed smoothly)
temples: Shrine at River Confluences
Birthing huts that appear where needed

protected: All beings born during water events

weaknesses: Powerless in completely dry environments
Cannot refuse a sincere request for help during birth/transition
Weakened by stagnant, polluted water

demi_gods.name: Kofi-Adesina
demi_gods.title: The Forged Judge
demi_gods.full_title: Blacksmith Who Hammered Truth From Lies
demi_gods.mortal_origin: Blacksmith and part-time judge in a trading city
demi_gods.ascension_story: Kofi discovered that metal retains the truth of what it witnesses. When a series of murders went unsolved, he forged a blade from the murder weapons and questioned it in the forge-fire. The metal sang the truth, revealing the killer. Ogun-No-Tetsu, impressed by this innovation, appeared in his forge and together they hammered Kofi's soul into a new shape—part man, part living metal, with a heart that beats like a forge bellows and eyes that see the truth in all worked metal.
demi_gods.appearance: A muscular man with skin like polished bronze, one arm of living iron that can reshape into tools, hair like iron filings, eyes that glow like hot coals. His breath smells of ozone and forge smoke. Wears a blacksmith's apron that never burns.

unique_abilities.name: Metal Memory
unique_abilities.effect: Can read the complete history of any metal object by touching it—who made it, who used it, what it witnessed
unique_abilities.limitations: Only works on worked metal; raw ore gives only geological history

unique_abilities.name: Truth-Temper
unique_abilities.effect: Can heat a metal object to force anyone holding it to speak only truth
unique_abilities.limitations: Object becomes brittle after use and may shatter

demi_gods.current_role: Wandering judge who uses metal to find truth
duties: Settles disputes where evidence is lacking
Tests weapons for purity of intent
Teaches blacksmiths the ethics of their craft
Maintains the Forge of Veracity
sacred_items: The Anvil of Truth (lies sound false when struck on it)
Hammer of Resolution (can reshape metal without heating)
temples: Forge-Temple in trading cities
Mobile anvil that appears at crossroads

rivals: Corrupt merchants who sell false goods

weaknesses: Cannot work with cold iron (immune to his powers)
Powerless against those who use no metal tools
Compelled to test any metal object presented as evidence

demi_gods.name: Esuola
demi_gods.title: The Path's Child
demi_gods.full_title: Messenger Who Never Forgets a Direction
demi_gods.mortal_origin: Orphan messenger in the great city of Ile-Ifa
demi_gods.ascension_story: Esuola had a perfect memory for paths and faces. When Eshu-No-Sakusen decided to test all messengers by sending them on impossible deliveries with contradictory instructions, only Esuola completed every task perfectly—remembering not just the words but the intent behind each message. Eshu, delighted by this faithfulness, gave him a portion of his own path-opening power, making Esuola's feet always find the right direction and his mouth always speak the message as intended.
demi_gods.appearance: A youth with eyes that show miniature maps of everywhere he's been, skin that subtly shifts to match his surroundings, feet that never seem to quite touch ground. Wears messenger's clothes with pockets that hold messages without wrinkling them.

unique_abilities.name: Perfect Recall Route
unique_abilities.effect: Can retrace any path he's taken, no matter how complex or magically obscured
unique_abilities.limitations: Only works for paths he personally traveled; cannot navigate unmapped areas

unique_abilities.name: Intent Delivery
unique_abilities.effect: His voice carries not just words but the sender's true intent, preventing misunderstanding
unique_abilities.limitations: Cannot add to or subtract from the message; only delivers exactly what was given

demi_gods.current_role: Chief messenger for divine communications
duties: Carries messages between Orishas
Guides lost travelers to their destinations
Teaches memory techniques to messengers
Maintains the Map of All Paths Traveled
followers: Those with poor sense of direction
sacred_items: The Unforgetting Satchel (holds infinite messages without mixing them)
Shoes of Sure Steps (never slip or take wrong turns)
temples: Shrine at Major Crossroads
Message depots in every major city

rivals: Those who deliberately give false directions

weaknesses: Cannot refuse a legitimate message delivery request
Gets lost in completely identical, featureless environments
Powerless against those who have no destination

demi_gods.name: Nneka-Iyi
demi_gods.title: The Healing Mud
demi_gods.full_title: Herbalist Who Learned Medicine From Swamp Spirits
demi_gods.mortal_origin: Herbalist who lived in the disease-ridden swamps
demi_gods.ascension_story: When a plague resistant to all known medicines swept through her village, Nneka went into the forbidden swamps to seek the most potent herbs. Instead of finding plants, she discovered that the mud itself held healing properties if approached with respect. She lived in the swamp for a year, learning its medicine, and emerged with the cure. Babalu-Aye-No-Iyashi, god of disease, was so impressed he shared his knowledge with her, making her skin absorb illness and her touch draw out corruption like mud draws out poison.
demi_gods.appearance: A woman with skin like healing mud that shifts between black, green, and brown, hair with medicinal plants growing from it, eyes that show the health status of whoever she looks at. Always slightly damp. Wears simple garments that filter impurities from the air.

unique_abilities.name: Fever Mud
unique_abilities.effect: Can create cooling, healing mud that draws out fever and infection
unique_abilities.limitations: Requires actual earth and water; cannot work in completely sterile environments

unique_abilities.name: Illness Sight
unique_abilities.effect: Can see diseases as visible patterns on people, animals, or places
unique_abilities.limitations: Cannot see mental illnesses or spiritual corruption, only physical ailments

demi_gods.current_role: Wandering swamp healer and plague specialist
duties: Heals diseases that resist conventional treatment
Teaches the medicinal properties of seemingly filthy places
Purifies plague-ridden areas
Maintains the Garden of Unpleasant Cures
sacred_items: The Mud Bowl (produces appropriate healing mud for any ailment)
Fever Cloth (cools any fever when placed on forehead)
temples: Swamp Sanctuaries
Healing huts in disease-prone areas

rivals: Those who fear and destroy wetlands

weaknesses: Weakened by overly clean, sterilized environments
Cannot heal diseases she hasn't personally encountered before
Compelled to help anyone suffering from plague or fever

demi_gods.name: Ife-Oluwa
demi_gods.title: The Destiny Weaver
demi_gods.full_title: Diviner Who Could Read the Patterns in Ordinary Things
demi_gods.mortal_origin: Market diviner who used everyday objects instead of traditional tools
demi_gods.ascension_story: Ife discovered that destiny leaves patterns in the most mundane things—the way seeds fall from a bird's beak, the pattern of cracks in drying mud, the arrangement of goods in a market stall. Her predictions using these 'accidental' methods were more accurate than traditional divination. Orunmila-No-Yogen, witnessing this innovation, gave her a set of palm nuts that were actually seeds from the first divination tree, and her eyes began to see the Odus (destiny patterns) in everything around her.
demi_gods.appearance: A woman with eyes that constantly shift through geometric patterns, skin that subtly shows the 256 Odus shifting beneath the surface, hair that arranges itself into meaningful patterns. Wears garments covered in apparently random designs that actually tell stories.

unique_abilities.name: Chance Reading
unique_abilities.effect: Can divine accurate information from completely random events (falling leaves, spilled water, bird flight patterns)
unique_abilities.limitations: Cannot force a reading; must wait for patterns to emerge naturally

unique_abilities.name: Pattern Translation
unique_abilities.effect: Can explain complex destinies in simple, everyday terms anyone can understand
unique_abilities.limitations: Sometimes oversimplifies; cannot reveal details the listener wouldn't comprehend

demi_gods.current_role: Diviner for common people using everyday methods
duties: Teaches divination using available materials
Interprets omens for those who can't afford traditional diviners
Maintains the Archive of Accidental Prophecies
Advises on seemingly minor decisions with major consequences
followers: Those who notice patterns others miss
sacred_items: The Bowl of Ordinary Signs (shows destiny in whatever is placed in it)
Pattern Cloth (can be thrown to create readable patterns)
temples: Market Corner Shrines
Divination huts made from found materials

rivals: Traditional diviners who reject her methods
Those who believe destiny cannot be read in mundane things

weaknesses: Cannot divine in completely controlled, patternless environments
Overwhelmed by too many simultaneous patterns
Compelled to interpret any pattern sincerely presented to her

egungun_ancestor_assemblies.description: Ancestral spirits who have earned divinity through exemplary lives, now serving as guides, protectors, and intermediaries between the living and the Orishas.

hierarchy.role: Govern the seven sacred family lines that trace back to the first humans

examples.name: Adeyemi-Okunrin
examples.title: First King of Ife
examples.appearance: A regal spirit wearing the beaded crown of the first king, body semi-transparent with family patterns visible within
duties: Maintains the integrity of royal bloodlines
Advises current kings on traditional law
Protects the city of Ile-Ife
Judges disputes between noble families
examples.unique_power: Can temporarily manifest the combined wisdom of all kings in his lineage when advising a worthy ruler

examples.name: Iya-Agbon
examples.title: First Mother of Crafts
examples.appearance: A maternal spirit with hands that show the tools of all crafts, surrounded by floating creations of ancestors
duties: Preserves lost crafting techniques
Blesses tools passed through generations
Inspires artisans to honor traditions
Maintains the Hall of Ancestral Creations
examples.unique_power: Can temporarily grant a living artisan the combined skill of all their craft ancestors

hierarchy.role: Handle specific aspects of ancestral guidance and protection

examples.name: Agbe-Ancestors
examples.title: Farmer Spirits Collective
examples.appearance: Spirits with bodies of fertile soil and growing plants, carrying ancestral farming tools
duties: Teach traditional farming methods
Protect family lands from spiritual corruption
Ensure proper crop rotation memory
Bless seeds saved from previous harvests

examples.name: Ogboni-Ancestors
examples.title: Council of Elder Judges
examples.appearance: Spirits wearing judicial regalia, with scales that weigh ancestral justice
duties: Maintain memory of all community agreements
Settle disputes according to traditional law
Enforce oaths sworn on ancestors' names
Protect sacred community spaces

hierarchy.role: Personal guardians and guides for specific families

types.appearance: Recognizable as recently deceased family members, glowing with gentle light, wearing traditional family garments
types.typical_domain: Family compounds, ancestral altars, gravesites
types.organization: Organized by family trees, with founding ancestors as ultimate authorities

types.appearance: Spirits that embody their professions (blacksmiths with metal limbs, weavers with thread bodies, etc.)
types.typical_domain: Workshops, markets, places of trade and craft
types.organization: Guild-based hierarchies with master ancestors leading

types.appearance: Spirits that merge with locations (river ancestors look watery, mountain ancestors look rocky, etc.)
types.typical_domain: Rivers, mountains, forests, villages, crossroads
types.organization: Territorial networks based on geographical relationships

egungun_ancestor_assemblies.recruitment: Become eligible after living an exemplary life, receiving proper burial rites, and being remembered and honored by living descendants for at least three generations
egungun_ancestor_assemblies.mortality: Fade if completely forgotten by the living, but can be revived if remembered and honored again
egungun_ancestor_assemblies.worship: Receive offerings at family altars, libations poured to ground, remembrance ceremonies, and naming children after them

ajogun_opposition_legions.description: Spiritual forces that work against human endeavors—not evil, but representing the necessary resistance that strengthens character and tests destiny.

hierarchy.role: Govern the fundamental oppositions that test human existence

examples.name: Iku-Ajala
examples.title: Death Who Waits
examples.appearance: A tall, serene figure with one side living flesh, one side skeletal, holding a measuring rod
duties: Ensures deaths occur at appointed times
Prevents unnatural life extension
Tests those who cheat death
Maintains the balance between life and death
examples.unique_power: Can see the exact thread of each life and when it should naturally end

examples.name: Arun-Tuturu
examples.title: Disease That Teaches
examples.appearance: A being covered in sores that bloom with medicinal plants, carrying a bag of germs and cures
duties: Tests community health and sanitation
Strengthens immune systems through exposure
Purges weak lines from populations
Forces medical innovation
examples.unique_power: Can create diseases that specifically test a community's values and cohesion

hierarchy.role: Handle specific types of opposition and testing

examples.name: Ofo-Aye
examples.title: Loss That Purifies
examples.appearance: A thin, constantly shifting spirit that passes through possessions, leaving only essential items
duties: Tests attachment to material goods
Forces innovation through scarcity
Reveals true priorities
Cleanses through loss

examples.name: Epe-Ala
examples.title: Curse That Corrects
duties: Enforces proper behavior through consequence
Carries out justified curses
Tests community justice systems
Maintains moral equilibrium

hierarchy.role: Personal testers and minor opposition spirits

types.appearance: Spirits that look like shadows of the people they test, with exaggerated flaws
types.typical_domain: Individual lives, personal crossroads, moments of decision
types.organization: Assigned by Orunmila based on individual destinies

types.appearance: Spirits that embody community problems (famine-testers look emaciated, conflict-testers look divided, etc.)
types.typical_domain: Villages, cities, organizations, families
types.organization: Deployed based on community karma and needs

types.appearance: Spirits that merge with natural forces (drought-testers look parched, storm-testers look turbulent, etc.)
types.typical_domain: Farms, trade routes, borderlands, wilderness
types.organization: Cyclical deployment based on natural and spiritual cycles

ajogun_opposition_legions.ascension_process: Created by Olodumare as necessary parts of creation, or formed from collective negative energy that needs structured expression
ajogun_opposition_legions.limitations: Cannot act beyond their assigned testing parameters; must withdraw when lesson is learned or destiny fulfilled
ajogun_opposition_legions.shrines: Small, respectful shrines at life's difficult places (hospital entrances, courts, border crossings)

abiku_spirit_circles.description: Spirits who cycle through repeated births and deaths, teaching lessons about attachment, impermanence, and the value of life.

types.appearance: Child spirits with old eyes, bodies that flicker between solid and spectral, wearing beads that mark their birth cycles
types.intelligence: Cyclical consciousness (understand repetition, pattern, gradual learning)
duties: Teach parents about non-attachment
Test family love and resilience
Force examination of child-rearing practices
Bring specific lessons each cycle
types.communication: Through dreams of previous lives, deja vu experiences, recognition of family patterns

types.appearance: Child spirits with healing light emanating from their illness marks, carrying small medicinal bags
types.intelligence: Remedial consciousness (understand cure through repeated exposure)
duties: Force medical advancement through repeated illnesses
Test community healthcare systems
Bring specific diseases to be studied and cured
Teach compassion for the sick
types.communication: Through symptoms that communicate needed treatments, medical intuition in caregivers

types.appearance: Child spirits with tools for hands, creative energy flowing from them, surrounded by unfinished projects
types.intelligence: Iterative consciousness (understand improvement through repetition)
duties: Bring artistic innovations through multiple attempts
Test teaching methods across generations
Preserve craft knowledge through repeated exposure
Force refinement of techniques
types.communication: Through inherited skills, sudden mastery in specific areas, artistic dreams

types.appearance: Groups of child spirits who manifest together, connected by visible bonds
types.intelligence: Collective consciousness (understand group dynamics through repeated formations)
duties: Test community child protection systems
Force examination of social structures
Bring specific social lessons each cycle
Strengthen community bonds through shared loss
types.communication: Through synchronized events, group memories, collective deja vu

abiku_spirit_circles.creation: Born when a spirit chooses a difficult learning path requiring multiple life cycles, or created by Orishas to teach specific lessons to families/communities
abiku_spirit_circles.lifespan: Continue cycling until their lesson is learned or their contract with the family/community is fulfilled
abiku_spirit_circles.worship: Special rituals to encourage them to stay, respectful burials when they leave, altars with their favorite toys/foods

ori_personal_destiny_guides.description: Personal destiny spirits chosen by each soul before birth. They are not worshipped but worked with, representing individual potential and life purpose.

notable_manifestations.name: Ogun-Ori
notable_manifestations.appearance: A miniature warrior spirit that sits on the right shoulder, armed and alert
notable_manifestations.manifestation_conditions: Manifests clearly when person faces physical danger or must protect others
notable_manifestations.power: Enhances combat skills, provides tactical insight, boosts courage in battle
notable_manifestations.limitation: Can become dominant, making person aggressive in non-combat situations

notable_manifestations.name: Awon-Ori
notable_manifestations.appearance: A gentle spirit with healing hands, sitting on the left shoulder, glowing with soothing light
notable_manifestations.manifestation_conditions: Manifests when encountering sickness or suffering
notable_manifestations.power: Enhances healing abilities, provides diagnostic intuition, guides to needed medicines
notable_manifestations.limitation: Can cause person to absorb others' suffering if not balanced

notable_manifestations.name: Onise-Ori
notable_manifestations.appearance: A creative spirit with multiple arms holding different tools, floating above the head
notable_manifestations.manifestation_conditions: Manifests during creative work or when inspiration is needed
notable_manifestations.power: Enhances creativity, provides technical skill, inspires innovative solutions
notable_manifestations.limitation: Can cause obsession with perfection or neglect of practical matters

ori_personal_destiny_guides.birth_process: Chosen by the soul before birth during its audience with Olodumare; represents the soul's chosen path and potential
ori_personal_destiny_guides.power_source: Draws strength from the person living according to their destiny; weakens when person acts against their true nature
ori_personal_destiny_guides.vulnerability: Can be confused or suppressed by strong external influences (society, family pressure, trauma)

ashe_energy_administrators.description: Divine bureaucrats who manage the flow, distribution, and balancing of Ashe (divine life-force) throughout the Shattered Expanse.

departments.head: Ala-Ashe, Mistress of Life-Force
departments.staff: 401 distributor-spirits (one for each Ori plus Olodumare)
duties: Allocate Ashe to newborn beings according to destiny
Reclaim Ashe at death for recycling
Balance Ashe flow between regions
Prevent Ashe hoarding or theft
departments.office_location: The Calabash of Existence, floating in Orun

departments.head: Ipin-Ori, Director of Personal Fate
duties: Ensure destinies unfold according to chosen patterns
Adjust minor details while maintaining major destiny threads
Record destiny deviations for cosmic accounting
Coordinate with Ajogun for destiny testing
departments.office_location: The Great Divination House, existing in all places where destiny is decided
